name: gannet
description: Your GitHub repos as a tree: browse files without cloning, check out into your workspace, push as the right account.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js bin/*.js; do [ ! -f "$f" ] || node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:offline: node test/github.test.js && node test/accounts.test.js && node test/state.test.js && node test/checkout.test.js && node test/tokenServer.test.js && node test/fsProvider.test.js
